name: Amoran
source:
Amoran – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change, an Aegis of Water.
Amoran' true form remains unknown. Om'verai imagine Baliarnas as an Om'verai-like bipedal blue creature, covered by water, with a short mane, head horns and whiskers.
